subject.title: fix(agents): route llama.cpp GBNF cleaning through provider tool-schema hooks

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support the `compat.toolSchemaProfile: "llamacpp"` custom-endpoint setting and export the `llamacpp-gbnf` provider-tools family, or should this compatibility behavior remain narrower and provider-local?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent and proven, but it creates a documented configuration value plus public plugin-SDK surface whose future support and deprecation policy cannot be inferred safely from code review.

options.title: Accept the public contracts
options.body: Merge the documented profile and SDK family as the supported extension mechanism for llama.cpp-backed custom endpoints and provider plugins.

options.title: Narrow to bundled providers
options.body: Keep the bundled provider hooks but remove or defer the custom profile and public SDK exports until a separate plugin API decision is made.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Hold the PR while maintainers define the desired long-term compatibility-profile and plugin-SDK surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the public contracts
recommendation.body: Merge the documented profile and SDK family as the supported extension mechanism for llama.cpp-backed custom endpoints and provider plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: They assembled the implementation, evidence, and contract documentation and can answer technical scoping questions, while final product acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
